record.title: Thailand Cambodia closure following border confrontation
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: All land checkpoints in seven border provinces
record.crossings: All land checkpoints in seven border provinces
record.direction: Entry and exit at Thai checkpoints; humanitarian exceptions changed by phase
record.exceptions: Discretionary medical, student and essential-life exemptions in June 23 directives; the second-region directive also described essential household trade. Repatriation and medical passages were later reported. July 24 advisory narrowed stated exceptions to humanitarian missions.
record.enforcement: Thai military restriction order reported June 23. RFA describes temporary outbound openings on June 25; the June 26 official account describes repatriation and medical crossings. July 25 advisory states tightened land measures effective July 24. June 2, 2026 provincial inspections report selected Sa Kaeo posts still closed; neither continuous physical closure nor cutoff status is inferred.
record.record_type: Restriction regime with differentiated passage phases
record.relationship: EA002 is an opposite-side goods-policy overlay; the Sampov Loun earthwork lead R13-AS-L001 remains unresolved and is not added as a duplicate physical closure.
record.status_observation: Latest adopted local closure confirmation: official Sa Kaeo inspection report dated 2026-06-02; later and frontier-wide status not inferred.
record.official_rationale: Border security and confrontation; authorities also cited scam-centre suppression.
record.context: June 7 phased controls preceded the broad June 23 order. June 25 temporary outbound passage and later July 24 tightening are materially different operation phases within this restriction regime; they do not establish one uninterrupted closure spell.
record.uncertainty: Full-regime endpoint and continuous scope remain unresolved. Temporary outbound and medical/repatriation passages prevent treating the regime as an uninterrupted all-person/all-goods spell. June 2026 confirmation is local and official, not universal field observation. Elite politics removed: the inspected reports establish domestic political context and repercussions, not that mechanism as the closure rationale.

historical.duration_note: Changing categories, temporary passages and unknown endpoint; no exact continuous interval.
